title: The board
about: `apps/web` shows the workflows to a person.

terms.meaning: `apps/web`, the pages a person looks at, which reach the api over HTTP alone.

a step of a run her chat message links to (`/runs/<run>?step=<step>`), drawn under her words as the run's page's own part for what it waits on, read live: its gate, the Answer section's row, the banner's Continue, the note of a try asked, or its state alone, as `broughtPart` names it (`apps/web/src/lib/brought.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/brought.contract.ts`), drawn by `apps/web/src/components/nemia/chat/ChatBrought.tsx`. A proposal her message links to (`/factories/<factory>/proposals/<name>`, read by `proposalLinkOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/proposalLink.ts`) is brought the same way, as the proposal page's own part (`ProposalCard`, `apps/web/src/components/gate/ProposalCard.tsx`), drawn by `apps/web/src/components/nemia/chat/ChatProposal.tsx`; her action ask is `ChatActions` (`apps/web/src/components/nemia/chat/ChatActions.tsx`).

a person's word for each phase of a factory's proposal, its sentence on hover and its hue, one writer: `PROPOSAL_WORDS` (`apps/web/src/lib/words.ts`); which of Approve and Decline a phase offers is `proposalOffers` (`apps/web/src/lib/proposals.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/proposal.contract.ts`).

what comes with Nemia, as the board says it: the place `builtin` of a skill, drawn 'Built into Nemia', the builtin servers above a factory's list and an agent's builtin auto rule. The former address `/agents/skills/shipped/<skill>` opens the builtin skill through the api's redirect.

terms.meaning: what the board offers a person for a waiting step, in the run's Answer section and its banner: its `kind` is the key of the step's `commands` whose line it presses (`retry`, `approve`, `say`), its `case` why the step waits (`answer`, `try-again`, `denied`, `raise`, `continue`, `enough`), and a person's words for each case are `OFFERS`'. A try already asked is a note beside the step, not an offer.

terms.meaning: the board's word for each start of a try's task, which the runtime calls an attempt: a try counts its sessions, one a start. Not the runtime's Session, an agent's conversation, which a try may continue.
which of the board's five groups a step is drawn in (work, gate, done, to come, failed), taken from its phase and whether it ran (`kindOf`).

the board's state of a step, drawn from its reason by one total table in `apps/web/src/lib/status.ts`, never from the words of its message; a question its session asks, `AwaitingAnswer` via `session`, is `asks-in-session`, and the runtime's `needs-human` is compared nowhere in the board (`apps/web/test/structure.test.ts`).

terms.meaning: one filing of a step, as the api serves it, with its cause; the board says try and never attempt.

the states of a step that wait on a person's word (`WAITS_ON_A_PERSON` in `apps/web/src/lib/status.ts`), read by `waitsOnPerson`; of them, the human gates (`AT_A_GATE`: signed off blocked, at its gate, a loop out of rounds, past its budget), read by `waitsAtGate` and drawn with the gate's badge. Neither waits on a run called off. A row's kind of wait (`WaitKind`, `apps/web/src/lib/runWords.ts`) for a step that signed off blocked is `answer`.

retired.card: 4c: a human gate is read by `waitsAtGate`, of the states `waitsOnPerson` reads

terms.meaning: the field over the Runs (`SelectorField`, `apps/web/src/components/field/SelectorField.tsx`) that keeps the runs a label selector takes (`team=core`, Kubernetes' spelling), written to the address as `?l=` and sent to the api as `?selector=`; a selector the api refuses is said in its words under the field.

the page of one label value, `/labels/<key>/<value>` (`apps/web/src/routes/labels.$key.$value.tsx`): the cards that carry it no run started, the runs that carry it counted by where each stands (waiting, running, needs a person, succeeded, failed, stopped), and what a merged one cost, each linking to its list filtered by it.

the factory a run or a card that names none is in, `default` (objects' `DEFAULT_NAMESPACE`), and the board's two converters of it, written once in `apps/web/src/lib/api/namespace.ts` and re-exported by `apps/web/src/lib/factories.ts`: `namespaceOf`, from a factory as the api answers it (null for the default) to its namespace, and `factoryIn`, the way back.

terms.meaning: one step as every size of it is drawn — the graph's node, the waiting card's modal, and whole in the ledger, the bar and the step's page — from one model, `stepPartOf` (`apps/web/src/lib/stepPart.ts`): six slots in an order a size never changes, only leaves some out (head, asks of you, got, said, gave, detail), each `none` where it does not apply, of the try the address shows (`?try=<step>:<n>`, `tryShown`, `apps/web/src/lib/tryAddress.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/try-shown.contract.ts`). Its head is the one writer of the words the step's card says (`headOf`).

what a step hands the step whose `input` names it: drawn on the graph's edge between them, labelled by the giver's name, with the fields and files the giver's shown try gave; the giver's Gave and the taker's Got say the same label (`packetsOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/canvas.ts`).
a folded record at the foot of a run's page, read when a person wants to check rather than act: its timeline, its checks, its specs, its tokens, and where it ran.

what draws a declared field of a step's output, chosen once per field from its schema and the shape its `x-shape` marks, never from its value, so the field looks the same before its step runs (a dash) and on every run: `widgetOf` (`apps/web/src/lib/fieldWidget.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/field-widget.contract.ts`).

what draws a step's file in a sheet with an address of its own (`?view=<step>/<path>`, `apps/web/src/lib/viewAddress.ts`), which Back closes: a picture, markdown, JSON or text, by the kind the api serves it as and its extension, never its bytes, and none for a file it cannot draw, offered by its link (`viewerOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/viewers.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/artifact-viewer.contract.ts`).

the frame's rail, 80 wide at the window's left on every page: her face, then the destinations that span the store in three groups — Across factories (Factories, Waiting), Yours (Agents, Skills), You (Stats, Settings) — then the account, to come (`RAIL_GROUPS`, `apps/web/src/components/nav/nav.ts`; drawn by `apps/web/src/components/frame/FrameRail.tsx`). Waiting carries the count of the runs that wait on the person in every factory. Under 768 pixels it is a drawer the menu button opens.

one factory's pane, 360 wide beside the rail on a page under its path: the switcher and Start a run at its head, then its places, Floor, Runs, Inbox, Workflows, Agents, Skills and Settings (`PANE_PLACES`, `apps/web/src/components/frame/FactoryPane.tsx`). How it stands — docked, folded by the menu button or Ctrl+B and kept in the `sidebar_state` cookie, covered by the side sheet under 1600 pixels, or in the drawer under 768 — is `frameFold`'s `pane` (`apps/web/src/lib/frameFold.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/frame-fold.contract.ts`).

the frame's foot, across the window under the rail, the pane, the page and the sheet: the machine's gauges button (the daemon, the runs and sessions, the feed, Nemia's presence and the quota in short), the version, then the pause (`apps/web/src/components/frame/MachineBar.tsx`). It holds what the top bar held; the page's head holds the page's name alone.

where a page sits in the frame, read from its path alone by `seatOf` (`apps/web/src/components/nav/nav.ts`): at the store's level under a destination of the rail, or at a factory's under a place of its pane; it says what the rail and the pane light, and the page's name (`pageNameOf`).

the address of a factory's place, `/factories/<name>/<place>`, a run's, a step's and a card's page included: the factory is a segment of the path, never a key of the search. Every old address that named it as `?factory=` is sent to its path, its other keys kept (`factoryRedirect`, `apps/web/src/lib/factoryAddress.ts`, in the root's `beforeLoad`), and a run's or a card's page to where its namespace says (`objectHome`).

how much of a run one drawing says: `xs` its mark in a sentence, `sm` a line, `md` a runs table's row or the floor's card, `lg` the waiting card, `xl` the opened floor card, its panel. Each size says all the one under it does and more (`says`, `apps/web/src/lib/runSays.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/run-says.contract.ts`), and one part draws them all, `Run` (`apps/web/src/components/look/Run.tsx`).

the page a fresh store opens on, `/welcome`, in place of the empty floor: a store with no harness activated and no factory filed, whose person has not skipped the harness in this browser (`welcomeAsked`, `apps/web/src/lib/welcome.ts`); it activates a harness and shows its two checks (`WelcomePage`, `apps/web/src/components/welcome/WelcomePage.tsx`).

the welcome's second milestone, `/welcome/factory`, reached by the harness step's Next: how to make a first factory, three ways in order (with Nemia in her chat, from a template, from scratch), and once the store's milestones read a factory filed, or a write of the page was answered, the factory made, with the short guide after an empty one (`factoryStepOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/factoryStep.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/factory-step.contract.ts`; `FactoryStep`, `apps/web/src/components/welcome/FactoryStep.tsx`).

the welcome's fourth milestone, `/welcome/card`: a card the person writes or picks among three fixed small changes, the cost of a small run said above Start (measured on this store's merged runs of the workflow, else a stated estimate), filed labelled `onboarding=first-card` and started in the workflow its factory names (`firstWorkflow`), gated at the step before that workflow's first wait node, or in a workflow of the factory's own choice where it names none it offers; the run's page then draws one hint a beat, read from the run as the api answers it (`firstWorkflowOf`, `costLineOf`, `firstBeatOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/firstCard.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/first-card.contract.ts`; `FirstCard` and `FirstHint`, `apps/web/src/components/welcome/`).

the welcome's last page, `/welcome/next`, shown once a run has succeeded: three next steps, raising Nemia's level, connecting the host a factory's template follows (only where its first volume was a folder of this machine), and Nemia from a terminal or a coding agent (`nextStepsOf`, `apps/web/src/lib/firstCard.ts`; `YouAreSet`, `apps/web/src/components/welcome/YouAreSet.tsx`). It replaced the floor's list of milestones.

retired.card: onboarding: a guided first card runs to a run that succeeded, then says what to do next

terms.meaning: a story's picture in the dark theme, Nemia's default, committed under `apps/web/test/approved/<story id>.png` and drawn in the pinned place (Ubuntu 24.04, the lockfile's Chromium: `apps/web/test/e2e/stories/pinned.ts`); the stories project compares every run of a story against it and fails on a difference (`apps/web/.storybook/compare.ts`), `npm run stories -- --update` writes those that differ, to commit with the change, and `apps/web/test/e2e/stories/changed.ts` hands those a change added, changed and removed. The folder owes one to every story and holds none astray (`unapprovedOf`, `apps/web/.storybook/approved.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/approved-pictures.contract.ts`).

a story approved in the light theme too, `apps/web/test/approved/light/<story id>.png`, one of the few that draw what the board writes for one scheme outside the theme's roles (`LIGHT_CANARIES`, `apps/web/.storybook/approved.ts`): light is held by the theme otherwise, its contrast pairs in both schemes (`apps/web/test/theme-contrast.test.ts`) and the palette guard, not by a picture of every story.

one of the two answers the board supplies on every question a step asks, after its options, as the Agent SDK's `AskUserQuestion` supplies "Other": "Something else" (`else`), which needs the person's words, and "None of these" (`none`), which stands without words, chooses no option and is sent as `none: true`. Held in the draft the series of questions writes (`apps/web/contracts/question-draft.contract.ts`, `apps/web/src/lib/question-draft/questionDraft.ts`), drawn by `QuestionSeries` (`apps/web/src/components/gate/Questions.tsx`).

the page, and each thing that opens over it: a dialog, a popover's form, a side sheet. It holds at most one filled action, the look's cut button (`apps/web/DESIGN.md`, *Ink and the one action*), counted in each drawn story by `filledViews` and judged by `overFilled` (`apps/web/.storybook/filled.ts`, proved by `apps/web/contracts/one-filled.contract.ts`); a button of the kit's or shadcn's drawn filled or as words alone is refused where it is written (`buttonForms`, `apps/web/test/stories.ts`).
